Am Kanal, hinter dem Hafen. Nachts glühe: By the canal, behind the harbour. At night the furnaces glow. Case 5.
Auf jeder Fotoplatte vom Ball der Ashcom: On every photo plate from the Ashcombes' ball there is a stranger. Since then the people photographed no longer cast a shadow.
Aus Miss Pimms Asservatenkammer fehlt da: The hymnal of the hospital choir of St. Ebba is missing from Miss Pimm's evidence room. Supposedly it is now in Mr. Quill's display case at the Old Market.
Aus Professor Starlings Gesteinsschrank: Shards from the meteorite crater are missing from Professor Starling's rock cabinet. At night his telescope shows lights in the clock tower.
Aus einem Oberschenkelknochen der Katako: Ground from a thighbone from the catacombs. The dead know it.
Aus gegerbter Moorhaut. Kalt, schwer und: Made of tanned moor hide. Cold, heavy and surprisingly tough.
Ballroom in the villa quarter. Case 6.
Barnaby schwört, er habe die Silberleuch: Barnaby swears he never touched the silver candlesticks of St. Ebba. The arrest report says otherwise.
Benji, der Zeitungsjunge, braucht eine G: Benji, the newspaper boy, needs a story for the morning edition. Otherwise he won't get paid.
Berichte Inspektorin Marlowe im Revier: Report to Inspector Marlowe at the precinct
Berichte Marlowe, was in St. Brigid gesc: Tell Marlowe what is happening at St. Brigid
Besiege, was Hester in der Krypta bewach: Defeat what guards Hester in the crypt
Bess Hagan vom Hafen schwört, Dr. Pratts: Bess Hagan from the harbour swears that Dr. Pratt's Miracle Tonic from the Night Market poisoned her husband.
Besuche das Waisenhaus St. Brigid in Ash: Visit St. Brigid's orphanage in Ashgrove
Brown, patched many times and full of pockets. There's always room somewhere.
Bring die Akte zu Miss Pimm: Bring the file to Miss Pimm
Bring es Miss Pimm ins Revier: Bring it to Miss Pimm at the precinct
Brunnen, Marktstände, Kapelle. Nebenauft: Fountain, market stalls, chapel. Side tasks.
Constables zeigen dir Dienstbücher und B: Constables show you duty logs and reports.
Das Archiv öffnet seine Unglücksakten. Z: The archive opens its misfortune files. Witnesses take you seriously.
Dein alter Spazierstock mit Messingknauf: Your old walking stick with a brass knob. Better than nothing.
Dem Altmarkt das Licht zurückgegeben: Gave the Old Market its light back
Der Bankier Josiah Thorne ist in seinem: The banker Josiah Thorne drowned in his locked counting house at the Old Market. His clothes are dry. Price thinks the nephew is guilty.
Der Ertrunkene vom Kanalhafen: The Drowned Man of the Canal Harbour
Der Klöppel des bronzenen Engels. Schwer: The clapper of the bronze angel. Heavy, but every strike rings on.
Der Lampenanzünder Elias Thorne ist in A: The lamplighter Elias Thorne has vanished in Ashgrove Lane. Only his lantern by the bridge no longer burns.
Der Uhrwerkwächter, den Hettie Brass’ al: The clockwork guardian built by Hettie Brass' old master walks through the tower at night, though nobody winds it.
Der alte Lampenanzünder Wick schafft die: Old lamplighter Wick can no longer manage the ladder. The four lanterns by the fountain ice over every night.
Der hohe Helm der Streife. Fängt so manc: The tall helmet of the patrol. Catches many a blow to the head.
Der kalte Kern eines vergangenen Geistes: The cold core of a departed ghost. Collectors pay well for it.
Die Diva des Lumen-Theaters hat über Nac: The diva of the Lumen Theatre lost her voice overnight. Since then the tower clock at the North Gate strikes three wrong notes at 3:33.
Die graue Kapuze der Sänger aus der Gieß: The grey hood of the singers from the foundry. The clasp hums softly.
Die letzten Seiten sind voller Noten, di: The last pages are full of notes that don't fit together, and one name: Lilian.
Die vierzehnjährige Hester Marsh ist ver: Fourteen-year-old Hester Marsh has disappeared. The same morning an opened child's grave was found in the churchyard of St. Ebba.
Drei Splitter aus dem Meteoritenkrater,: Three shards from the meteorite crater, wrapped in oilcloth. They hold on to a faint light.
Dritte Klasse, einfache Fahrt, ausgestel: Third class, one way, issued in a name that isn't yours. The train leaves at dawn.
Du bist neu in der Stadt: ein freier Erm:
You are new in town: a freelance investigator whom the Kettlegate police station hires when the constables are at a loss. And lately they often are.

Nobody trusts you here yet. Your reputation with the police decides which files you may read and who talks to you.

Report to Inspector Marlowe. Her office is at the back right.
Du kannst aus jedem Kampf fliehen: You can flee from any fight
Dunkelgrünes Ölzeug, wie es die Kanalsch: Dark green oilskin, as the canal boatmen wear. Rain simply beads off.
Ein Anhänger aus Sternglas, in dem ein w: A pendant of star glass with a soft light trapped inside.
Ein Anhänger mit einem Auge im Kreis. Er: A pendant with an eye in a circle. It sees what you overlook.
Ein Dirigentenstab aus Silber. Er schläg: A conductor's baton of silver. It beats the time, and ghosts must follow.
Ein Fetzen Dunkelheit in einem Glas. Er: A scrap of darkness in a jar. It clings to the wall farthest from the lamp.
Ein Geschenk von Ada Whitlock. „Damit Si: A gift from Ada Whitlock. “So you have something that only shows what is there.”
A glass of water with green threads in it. It smells of the canal.
Ein Glasauge. Es scheint dir zu folgen,: A glass eye. It seems to follow you when you walk.
Ein Handspiegel mit gesprungenem Glas. I: A hand mirror with cracked glass. Sometimes something moves in the crack.
Ein Herz aus bleichem Wachs mit einem Do: A heart of pale wax with a wick. It warms the chest.
Ein Hügel vor der Stadt, ein Teleskop, e: A hill outside the city, a telescope, a professor.
Ein Krämer verkauft am Nordtor „Mut in F: A peddler at the North Gate sells “courage in bottles”. Three dead. He's hard to catch because he never stands in the same place twice.
Ein Laternendieb, der am Altmarkt die Ga: A lantern thief who steals the gas mantles at the Old Market. The alleys have been dark ever since, and more than theft happens in dark alleys.
Ein Messinggerät von Ada Whitlock. Die N: A brass instrument from Ada Whitlock. The needle trembles where shadows are missing.
Ein Messingschlüssel, an dem eine Krähen: A brass key with a crow feather hanging from it.
An umbrella with a hidden blade. Very proper, very sharp.
Ein Reif aus dem Geweih des Sternhirschs: A circlet from the antlers of the star stag. The starlight in it never goes fully dark.
Ein Ritualdolch der Stillen Waage, die K: A ritual dagger of the Silent Scale, the blade ground to the weight of a heartbeat. Only traded among members.
Ein Taschentuch mit fremdem Monogramm. I: A handkerchief with someone else's monogram. Somebody misses it.
Ein Weihrauchfass an langer Kette. Der R: An incense burner on a long chain. The smoke bites everything that doesn't breathe.
A lilac ribbon full of knots. Every knot is a memory.
Ein gezackter Splitter aus Quills Spiege: A jagged splinter of Quill's mirror. The edge is frosted, and your reflection in it moves a heartbeat too late.
Ein graues Chorgewand mit Kapuze. Es rie: A grey hooded choir robe. It smells of incense and cold churches.
Ein grünes Glasfläschchen an einer Kette: A green glass vial on a chain. Something bubbles inside, very quietly.
Ein rostiger Eisenring. Kaltes Eisen häl: A rusty iron ring. Cold iron holds what would otherwise fall apart.
Ein runder Hut für den ordentlichen Herr: A round hat for the proper gentleman. People take you more seriously.
Ein scharfer Atemzug klärt den Kopf. +40: One sharp breath clears the head. +40 nerves.
Ein schlichter grauer Wollmantel. Hält W: A plain grey wool coat. Keeps out wind and wet.
Ein schwarzer Zylinder, im Band steckt e: A black top hat with a silver half mask tucked in the band.
Ein schwarzes Medaillon, darin eine winz: A black locket with a tiny silhouette inside. Sometimes it moves.
Ein schwerer Ring mit fremdem Wappen. Hä: A heavy ring with a foreign crest. Merchants become polite.
Ein schweres Eisen. Öffnet Kisten, Türen: A heavy iron. Opens crates, doors and skulls.
Eine Fibel aus dunklem Glas, geformt wie: A brooch of dark glass, shaped like a feather.
Eine Holzspule mit einem Faden, der nur: A wooden spool with a thread you can only see from the corner of your eye. It is warm like a sleeping child.
Eine Klinge aus Sternglas. Sie leuchtet,: A blade of star glass. It glows just before it strikes.
Eine Pestarztmaske mit Kräutern im Schna: A plague doctor's mask with herbs in the beak. No stench gets through.
Eine Witwe vor falschem Verdacht bewahrt: Saved a widow from false suspicion
Eine dunkle Kapuze, die das Gesicht in S: A dark hood that casts the face into shadow.
Eine eiserne Stimmgabel, so lang wie ein: An iron tuning fork as long as an arm. Its tone tears ghosts apart.
Eine flache Mütze, wie sie jeder Hafenar: A flat cap like every dock worker wears. No one looks twice.
Eine geschwärzte Schachthacke aus den St: A blackened mining pick from the tunnels of the Soot Society. Clumsy, but it hits hard.
Eine gesprungene Phiole aus Sternglas. D: A cracked vial of star glass. Inside, a woman's voice softly sings scales.
Eine kurze Harpune der Salzbrüder, die S: A short harpoon of the Salt Brothers, the tip hardened in brine. The best thing changing hands under the counter in Wexmoor.
A pink cameo shaped like a mask.
Eine rostige Kette, die die Lichtlosen e: A rusty chain the Lightless hang in the moor for one night. Afterwards it swallows every glow.
Eine schmale Klinge im Stock, mit Silber: A slim blade inside the cane, inlaid with silver. It does far more against the occult.
Eine schwere Handglocke des Kreidezirkel: A heavy hand bell of the Chalk Circle. Its strike is dull, its sound breaks apparitions.
Eine schwere Laterne mit Linse. Als Keul: A heavy lantern with a lens. It works as a club, and its light burns ghosts.
Eine trübe Perle aus dem Moor an einer K: A cloudy pearl from the moor on a chain. It is always damp.
Eine türkisfarbene Muschel an einer Schn: A turquoise shell on a cord. Listen into it and you hear the room behind you.
Eine weiße Halbmaske an einem Band. Hint: A white half mask on a ribbon. Behind it your gaze stays calm.
Eine winzige Messinglaterne mit bernstei: A tiny brass lantern with an amber glow.
Eine winzige Spieldose. Sie spielt drei: A tiny music box. It plays three notes and then stops, as if waiting for an answer.
Eine winzige silberne Spieldose. Ihr Lie: A tiny silver music box. Its song calms even Miriam's choir.
Einen Dieb im Schlachthof gestellt: Caught a thief at the slaughterhouse
Eisenring am Lederband: Iron ring on a leather cord

Erzähl Tobias, was mit Nate geschah: Tell Tobias what happened to Nate

Fall 5: Der Chor in der Glocke: Case 5: The Choir in the Bell
Fall 8: Die Schlafwandler von St. Brigid: Case 8: The Sleepwalkers of St. Brigid
Falsche Schillinge auf dem Altmarkt, ein: Fake shillings at the Old Market, brought in from the Night Market. The merchants are at each other's throats because nobody knows what's real any more.

Finde heraus, woran Jack Hagan wirklich: Find out what Jack Hagan is really ill with

Finde zwei Quellen dafür, wer betrügt: Find two sources for who is cheating
Finde zwei Quellen dafür, wer die Kerzen: Find two sources for who sets out the candles
Finde zwei Quellen dafür, wer hinter der: Find two sources for who is behind the mask
Finde zwei Quellen dafür, wer stiehlt: Find two sources for who is stealing

Frag in Ashgrove herum, was im Nebel lau: Ask around Ashgrove what lurks in the fog (optional: Kit)

Gas lanterns by the canal. Case 1.
Gebrannter Lehm, innen glatt wie Haut. W: Fired clay, smooth as skin inside. Hold it to your ear and you hear seven breaths.
Getrocknete Blüten, Mohn und etwas Silbr: Dried blossoms, poppy and something silvery that looks like cobwebs.
Geweihtes Salz in einem Papierbeutel. Im: Consecrated salt in a paper pouch. Thrown in combat: 8 damage, double against the occult.
Gib Benji eine Geschichte (überleg dir,: Give Benji a story (think about which one)
Glas, schwer und kühl. Dreizehn Gesichte: Glass, heavy and cool. Thirteen faces where there should be twelve.
Greta hört nachts ein Heulen aus dem Neb: At night Greta hears howling from the fog by the canal. Something took the baker's dog.
Greta wants to sell flowers at the Old Market. Market warden Grimes demands money she doesn't have.

Grünlich, süß, mit einem Etikett voller: Greenish, sweet, with a label full of medals nobody ever awarded.
Heiß, süß, mit zu viel Nelke. Stellt 18: Hot, sweet, too much clove. Restores 18 health, +10 nerves.
Hester ist im Revier aufgewacht. Sie eri: Hester has woken up at the precinct. She remembers a man in a police coat. Someone at the precinct is working for Miriam Vey.
Hoch, schwarz und ein wenig zu elegant f: Tall, black and a little too elegant for the alleys.
Hol das Gesangbuch bei Mr. Quill: Get the hymnal from Mr. Quill
Hol dir das Kopfgeld am Brett im Revier: Collect the bounty at the board in the precinct

In Mr. Quills Auslage steht ein Spiegel,: In Mr. Quill's window stands a mirror that makes people stop and never walk on.
Inspektorin Marlowe hat Post bekommen, d: Inspector Marlowe has received mail that concerns you. Talk to her at the precinct.
Inspektorin Marlowe hat einen neuen Fall: Inspector Marlowe has a new case for you. Talk to her at the precinct.
Ivy glaubt, dass Hester ihr Medaillon in: Ivy believes Hester was wearing her locket the night she disappeared.
Jeden Morgen stehen sieben schwarze Kerz: Every morning seven black candles stand in front of the Old Market chapel. Father Ambrose believes Vey's choir is mocking him.
Jemand trägt eine von Jonas Pells Masken: Someone wearing one of Jonas Pell's masks is robbing guests in the foyer of the Lumen Theatre. The police suspect the butcher's apprentice Finn.
Kalt und schwer. Wenn du sie bewegst, su: Cold and heavy. When you move it, it softly hums a lullaby.
Leg Sergeant Holt die Beweise vor: Present the evidence to Sergeant Holt
Lumen-Theater, Uhrturm, Schlachthof. Fal: Lumen Theatre, clock tower, slaughterhouse. Case 4.
Mag Ashdown, die Schmugglerkönigin, behe: Mag Ashdown, the Smuggler Queen, rules the canals. Marlowe has put the highest bounty in the city on her. Her people won't betray her, but maybe her goods will.
Magnesium in einer Papiertüte. Im Kampf:: Magnesium in a paper bag. In combat: a blinding flash, 4 damage, the enemy skips a round.
Navy cape with a brass clasp. Surplus stock from the precinct.
Melde den Fund Inspektorin Marlowe: Report the find to Inspector Marlowe
Messing über den Knöcheln. Klein, schnel: Brass over the knuckles. Small, quick and nasty.
Messinggläser an einer Lederkappe. Rauch: Brass lenses on a leather cap. Smoke and sparks no longer bother you.
Miriam Veys dunkler Taktstock mit Bronze: Miriam Vey's dark baton with a bronze tip. It still trembles from the last song.
Miss Pimm vermisst Akte 47. Zuletzt hat: Miss Pimm is missing file 47. A constable took it last.
Miss Wrens Schere. Sie schneidet Fäden,: Miss Wren's scissors. They cut threads that don't exist.
Mott Gale bekommt keinen Arbeiter mehr i: Mott Gale can't get workers into the old gas tunnels any more. Something down there croaks that is bigger than a dog.
Mr. Halloway hat eine versetzte Taschenu: Mr. Halloway has a pawned pocket watch that was never collected. The engraving reads “For E., from G.”
Namen, Beträge, Fristen. Bei St. Brigid: Names, sums, deadlines. Next to St. Brigid: “Paid? No. Thorne dead. Now what?”
Nan Kettle sagt, die Kinder aus dem Wais: Nan Kettle says the children of St. Brigid's orphanage in Ashgrove walk in their sleep at night. A boy named Benji has disappeared.
Nan Kettle wartet am Nachtmarkt auf dich: Nan Kettle is waiting for you at the Night Market. It's about the orphans of St. Brigid. You won't get this case from Marlowe.
Ned sitzt am Brunnen und hört alles, was: Ned sits by the fountain and hears everything whispered at the Old Market. His frostbitten hands need a bandage.
Nenne Inspektorin Marlowe den Maulwurf: Name the mole to Inspector Marlowe

Optional: Was will Vey als Nächstes? (St: Optional: What does Vey want next? (St. Ebba, Agnes Crane)

Optional: Wie bricht man die Glocke? (Uh: Optional: How do you break the bell? (clockmaker, observatory)
Pflaumenfarbener Samt. In feinen Häusern: Plum-coloured velvet. In fine houses it opens doors and mouths.
Porzellan, innen mit Samt gefüttert. Rie: Porcelain, lined with velvet. Smells of gin and stage make-up.
Priester der Altmarkt-Kapelle: Priest of the Old Market chapel
Reise zur Ruine von St. Ebba: Travel to the ruins of St. Ebba
Riecht nach Metall und kaltem Glas. Dari: Smells of metal and cold glass. Flakes float in it, turning away from the light.
Schlösser im Revier öffnen sich mit 5 An: Locks in the precinct open with 5 less reputation
Schwarzer Frack vom Maskenball. Wer ihn: Black tailcoat from the masked ball. Whoever wears it is let in everywhere.
Schwarzer Schleier vor dem Gesicht. Die: A black veil before the face. The dead leave you to mourn in peace.
Schwarzes Leder, feucht wie nach einem R: Black leather, damp as if after rain. A thin mist rises between the pages, and sometimes something hums inside.
Schwarzes Leder, steif wie ein Brett. Kl: Black leather, stiff as a board. Blades slide off it.
Sechs Schuss, laut und unhöflich. Gegen: Six shots, loud and rude. Of limited use against ghosts.
Sichere beides mit je zwei Quellen ab: Back up both with two sources each
Sichere die Schlussfolgerungen mit je zw: Back up the conclusions with two sources each

Sieben Frauennamen in Miriams Handschrif: Seven women's names in Miriam's handwriting. Behind each one a note: C, E-flat, G …
Sieh dich im Lumen-Theater am Nordtor um: Look around the Lumen Theatre at the North Gate
Sieh dich in der Glockengießerei Brannoc: Look around the Brannock bell foundry
Sieh dir das Atelier Whitlock am Altmark: Have a look at the Whitlock studio at the Old Market
Sieh dir das Kontor Thorne am Altmarkt a: Have a look at the Thorne counting house at the Old Market
Silber, zerkratzt, steht auf zehn vor zw: Silver, scratched, stopped at ten to twelve. Engraving: “For E., from G.”
Silbrige Fäden durchziehen den Stoff. Am: Silvery threads run through the fabric. At the hem it dissolves into mist.
Sorge dafür, dass Greta ihren Stand beko: Make sure Greta gets her stall
Sprich mit Dr. Fenwick im Krankenzimmer: Talk to Dr. Fenwick in the precinct infirmary
Sprich mit Inspektorin Marlowe (Büro hin: Talk to Inspector Marlowe (office at the back right)
Sprich mit Lady Ashcombe in ihrer Villa: Talk to Lady Ashcombe in her villa
Stell Miriam Vey in der Resonanzkammer: Confront Miriam Vey in the resonance chamber
Stell den Täter im Uhrturm: Confront the culprit in the clock tower
Stell den dreizehnten Gast im Spiegelkab: Confront the thirteenth guest in the hall of mirrors
Stell dich dem Ding am Ostende des Kanal: Face the thing at the east end of the canal
Stelle das Ziel (Altmarkt, nachts): Catch the target (Old Market, at night)
Stelle die Schmugglerkönigin (Hafen, nac: Catch the Smuggler Queen (harbour, at night)

Suche das Medaillon auf dem Friedhof und: Search for the locket in the churchyard and the ruins

Versengtes, schweres Leder aus der Gieße: Scorched, heavy leather from the foundry. Keeps off sparks and blows.
Versiegelt, adressiert an das Polizeiamt: Sealed, addressed to the Wexmoor police office. Signed with a name Marlowe never uses.
Versiegelte Akten, vertrauliche Gespräch: Sealed files, confidential talks with the inspector. Suspects crack faster.
Vertreibe, was in der Archivecke haust: Drive out whatever lives in the archive corner
Vom Revier ausgegeben. Schwer und gut au: Issued by the precinct. Heavy and well balanced.
Von Meisterin Hettie gestimmt. Ihr Ton i: Tuned by Master Hettie. Its pitch is a hair off, and that's exactly the point.
Wasserprobe aus dem Kontor: Water sample from the counting house
Wer hatte einen Grund? Lies Thornes Brie: Who had a motive? Read Thorne's letters
Wicks Spezialmischung in einer Blechflas: Wick's special blend in a tin flask. Thrown in combat: 10 damage, double against the occult.
Zwölf Gäste, die Fotografin, die Gastgeb: Twelve guests, the photographer, the hostess. No one else.
Zünde die vier Laternen am Brunnen wiede: Relight the four lanterns by the fountain
Über Kettlegate steht ein neuer Stern, P: A new star stands over Kettlegate, Professor Starling has vanished, and anonymous letters about you are arriving at the precinct.
„St. Brigid, Ashgrove. Räumung zum Monat: “St. Brigid, Ashgrove. Eviction at the end of the month.” Signed by Josiah Thorne.
